entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I please have your name and email address?
It's Alex Smith, a.smith@email.com.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 41 days ago. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter. I just don't want it.
Okay, I understand. Looking at the timeline, since this is a wearable device, I'm not sure a return is possible. It's often **too late** after this much time has passed.
Why?

Well, our return **policy** on wearables has to consider health and safety. For **sanitation** and **hygiene** reasons, we can't typically accept them back after they've been out of our controlled environment for so long... one moment.
Of course. Knew it.

Actually, my apologies. I was referencing an incorrect policy. Let me correct that. I've just double-checked our internal knowledge base, and your specific model, the VeloBand GPS Tracker, is covered by our standard 10-day return window. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Oh. So you can do it?
Yes, absolutely. My mistake. I can process this return for you immediately. I've just initiated it in the system.
Fine. Whatever. What happens now?

I've sent a return confirmation to your email. It includes a prepaid shipping label. Just place the VeloBand and all its accessories back in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome, Alex. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
